title: The Death Knell of the Tang Dynasty
synopsis: The Tang dynasty (618-907) came to an end through various uprisings and what could even be the most terrible and cruel matter in history.

fullText.simplified:
大唐灭亡的丧钟

    唐朝末年，皇室生活奢侈，完全不顾及百姓的生活。
    比如，唐朝倒数第三个皇帝唐僖宗，最喜欢赌！而且他觉得赌钱不过瘾，还想了一个花招，用官职来作赌注。如果有人赌赢了，不管那个人有没有才能，都可以做官。
    皇帝这样干，下面大大小小的官员也跟着学。所以，唐朝末年，官员贪污腐败，各种苛捐杂税使得农民负担不断加重，生活困苦。雪上加霜的是，关东地区发生了严重的旱灾，粮食收成大大减少。
    没想到朝廷不但不减免税收，救济百姓，反而不断催促收税。在这样的背景下，大唐风雨飘摇，各地起义军频频爆发，其中最著名的就是黄巢起义。
    黄巢起义的首领王仙芝和黄巢都曾是贩卖私盐的商贩，对唐朝的统治早有不满。起义队伍起初发展迅速，捷报频传。但不久之后，朝廷劝导他们投降，导致起义队伍分裂。王仙芝兵败被杀，而黄巢转战南北几千里，最后占领了长安，即位做了皇帝，国号大齐。
    得了天下以后，黄巢军队开始迅速腐化堕落，到处抢劫，享尽荣华富贵。因为黄巢并没有花精力去治理国家，他的军队很快就没有粮草了，该怎么办呢？黄巢居然想出了一个食人的办法。他们把老百姓悄悄抓到军营，碾成肉泥当军粮吃！这种手段不仅仅是中国历史上最丧心病狂的事情，甚至也是世界历史上最恐怖残忍的记录。
    很快，在黄巢军队的吞食之下，人口开始急剧地减少，百里之内人迹全无。老百姓终于看清了黄巢的真面目，原来他并不是什么旷世明君，而是一个混世魔王！于是，人们秘密组织了一个军队，一鼓作气将黄巢赶出了长安。
    没想到黄巢并没有因此放弃长安，反而之后又杀了回来，将长安城中的所有的百姓进行了屠杀。这一手段，黄巢称之为“洗城”，即将城中所有的男性壮年全部屠杀，整个长安城中被屠杀的百姓高达八万多人。
    由于没有稳固的基础，特别是吃人的举动深深伤害了普通百姓，黄巢起义最终被镇压，黄巢选择了自杀。起义虽然失败，但它给了已经命悬一线的唐朝最后一击。奄奄一息的大唐帝国，很快就寿终正寝了。
fullText.traditional:
大唐滅亡的喪鐘

    唐朝末年，皇室生活奢侈，完全不顧及百姓的生活。
    比如，唐朝倒數第三個皇帝唐僖宗，最喜歡賭！而且他覺得賭錢不過癮，還想了一個花招，用官職來作賭注。如果有人賭贏了，不管那個人有沒有才能，都可以做官。
    皇帝這樣幹，下面大大小小的官員也跟著學。所以，唐朝末年，官員貪污腐敗，各種苛捐雜稅使得農民負擔不斷加重，生活困苦。雪上加霜的是，關東地區發生了嚴重的旱災，糧食收成大大減少。
    沒想到朝廷不但不減免稅收，救濟百姓，反而不斷催促收稅。在這樣的背景下，大唐風雨飄搖，各地起義軍頻頻爆發，其中最著名的就是黃巢起義。
    黃巢起義的首領王仙芝和黃巢都曾是販賣私鹽的商販，對唐朝的統治早有不滿。起義隊伍起初發展迅速，捷報頻傳。但不久之後，朝廷勸導他們投降，導致起義隊伍分裂。王仙芝兵敗被殺，而黃巢轉戰南北幾千里，最後佔領了長安，即位做了皇帝，國號大齊。
    得了天下以後，黃巢軍隊開始迅速腐化墮落，到處搶劫，享盡榮華富貴。因為黃巢並沒有花精力去治理國家，他的軍隊很快就沒有糧草了，該怎麼辦呢？黃巢居然想出了一個食人的辦法。他們把老百姓悄悄抓到軍營，碾成肉泥當軍糧吃！這種手段不僅僅是中國歷史上最喪心病狂的事情，甚至也是世界歷史上最恐怖殘忍的記錄。
    很快，在黃巢軍隊的吞食之下，人口開始急劇地減少，百里之內人跡全無。老百姓終於看清了黃巢的真面目，原來他並不是什麼曠世明君，而是一個混世魔王！於是，人們秘密組織了一個軍隊，一鼓作氣將黃巢趕出了長安。
    沒想到黃巢並沒有因此放棄長安，反而之後又殺了回來，將長安城中的所有的百姓進行了屠殺。這一手段，黃巢稱之為“洗城”，即將城中所有的男性壯年全部屠殺，整個長安城中被屠殺的百姓高達八萬多人。
    由於沒有穩固的基礎，特別是吃人的舉動深深傷害了普通百姓，黃巢起義最終被鎮壓，黃巢選擇了自殺。起義雖然失敗，但它給了已經命懸一線的唐朝最後一擊。奄奄一息的大唐帝國，很快就壽終正寢了。

sentences.english: Huang Chao called this strategy ”cleansing the city”, that is, massacring all the able-bodied men in the city.
More than 80,000 ordinary people were massacred within Chang’an city.

sentences.simplified: 由于没有稳固的基础，特别是吃人的举动深深伤害了普通百姓，
sentences.traditional: 由於沒有穩固的基礎，特別是吃人的舉動深深傷害了普通百姓，
sentences.pinyin: yóu yú méi yǒu wěn gù de jī chǔ tè bié shì chī rén de jǔ dòng shēn shēn shāng hài le pǔ tōng bǎi xìng

sentences.simplified: 黄巢起义最终被镇压，黄巢选择了自杀。
sentences.traditional: 黃巢起義最終被鎮壓，黃巢選擇了自殺。
sentences.pinyin: huáng cháo qǐ yì zuì zhōng bèi zhèn yā huáng cháo xuǎn zé le zì shā
sentences.english: As a result of not having stable foundations, in particular the cannibalist move deeply harmed the common people ..

sentences.simplified: 起义虽然失败，但它给了已经命悬一线的唐朝最后一击。
sentences.traditional: 起義雖然失敗，但它給了已經命懸一線的唐朝最後一擊。
sentences.pinyin: qǐ yì suī rán shī bài dàn tā gěi le yǐ jīng mìng xuán yí xiàn de táng cháo zuì hòu yì jī
sentences.english: .. the Huang Chao Rebellion was finally suppressed and Huang Chao chose to commit suicide.

sentences.simplified: 奄奄一息的大唐帝国，很快就寿终正寝了。
sentences.traditional: 奄奄一息的大唐帝國，很快就壽終正寢了。
sentences.pinyin: yǎn yǎn yī xī de dà táng dì guó hěn kuài jiù shòu zhōng zhèng qǐn le
sentences.english: Even though the uprising failed, for the Tang dynasty whose fate was hanging by a thread, it was the final blow.
The Tang dynasty was on on the verge of death, and very soon died a natural death.

raw.synopsis: The Tang dynasty (618-907) came to an end through various uprisings and what could even be the most terrible and cruel matter in history.
sentence_translations: The Death Knell of the Tang Dynasty
In the final years of the Tang dynasty, the imperial family lived extravagantly, ..
.. completely failing to attend to the lives of the common people.
For example, the third-last emperor of the Tang dynasty, Emperor Xizong of Tang, was most fond of gambling!
He thought that betting with money was not gratifying enough.
He even came up with a new trick: using official positions as stakes.
If someone won the bet, regardless of whether that person had any ability, they could still take an official post.
As the emperor behaved like this, officials at all levels below him also copied the emperor.
As a result, in the final years of the Tang dynasty, officials were corrupt.
All kinds of exorbitant taxes and levies unceasingly increased the burdens on peasants and made their lives miserable.
What made things worse was that in the Northeast China region a serious drought occurred, greatly reducing the harvest.
But the court not only did not reduce taxation and extend relief to the common people, ..
.. on the contrary, it unceasingly extracted taxes.
In this context, the Tang dynasty was very unstable.
Uprisings repeatedly broke out in different places. Of these, the most famous was the Huang Chao Rebellion.
The leaders of the Huang Chao Rebellion Wang Xianzhi and Huang Chao were both salt bootleggers, ..
.. and had long been dissatisfied with the Tang dynasty rule.
The rebellion grew rapidly at first, with many successes.
But not long afterwards, the court tried to convince them to surrender, causing a split in the rebel forces.
Wang Xianzhi’s forces were defeated and killed, ..
.. but Huang Chao continued to fight north and south, covering thousands of li.
Finally, he occupied Chang’an, becoming emperor with the dynastic name Da Qi.
After conquering the realm, Huang Chao’s troops rapidly descended into corruption, ..
..  looting everywhere, exhausting their high position and great wealth.
Because Huang Chao did not expend energy on governing the country or consolidating his rule, ..
.. very soon his troops lacked any provisions. What should he do?
Huang Chao actually came up with cannibalism as a solution.
They quietly snatched ordinary people and took them to the barracks to be ground into minced meat as provisions for the troops!
This method was not merely the most deranged occurrence in China’s history, ..
.. it was even the most terrible and cruel occurrence in the history of the world.
With the devouring of Huang Chao’s troops, the population started to rapidly decrease.
There was not a single trace of a person within one hundred li.
The ordinary people finally saw Huang Chao for what he really was.
As it turns out, he wasn’t some outstanding wise monarch, but a devil incarnate!
As a result, the people secretly organized an army, and in one sustained effort drove Huang Chao out of Chang’an.
Unexpectedly, Huang Chao did not consequently give up Chang’an, ..
.. but instead fought his way back and massacred all the ordinary people within Chang’an city.
Huang Chao called this strategy ”cleansing the city”, that is, massacring all the able-bodied men in the city.
More than 80,000 ordinary people were massacred within Chang’an city.
As a result of not having stable foundations, in particular the cannibalist move deeply harmed the common people ..
.. the Huang Chao Rebellion was finally suppressed and Huang Chao chose to commit suicide.
Even though the uprising failed, for the Tang dynasty whose fate was hanging by a thread, it was the final blow.
The Tang dynasty was on on the verge of death, and very soon died a natural death.
